name: ai-job-prospecting
description: Marketplace for the Job Prospecting plugin: tailored and speculative application packs grounded in your master CV, with SQLite tracking and stats.

plugins.name: job-prospecting
plugins.description: Job search automation: generate tailored application packs (CV, motivation letter, LinkedIn messages, interview prep) from a job offer, or speculative cold-application packs from just a company name — grounded in your master CV so nothing is invented. Tracks applications in SQLite with duplicate detection, status updates, and stats/skill-gap reporting.
